model.name: RbDiffEditor.computeFoldRegions
model.note: R30.51 (architect setHiddenAreas design). camelCase for [impl]. STRUCTURAL non-collapsibility: editor option folding:false (native OFF) + computeFoldRegions() emits gaps as the COMPLEMENT of conflicts[] change-ranges (CENTER span / LEFT aStart+a / RIGHT bStart+b). A change line is NEVER in a hidden range -> non-collapsible BY CONSTRUCTION (no foldingRangeProvider, no re-expand handler). Realizes UC merge.changeRegionNotCollapsible.
